Correspondence of native std/error/abort/effects remains a separate boundary. -/
def mapError {T E F O : Type} (f : core.ops.function.FnOnce O E F)
    (r : core.result.Result T E) (state : O) : Result (core.result.Result T F) :=
  match r with
  | .Ok value => ok (.Ok value)
  | .Err error => do let mapped ← f.call_once state error; ok (.Err mapped)

/-- Owned slice-to-array VALUE interpretation. No ownership, allocation,
cleanup or native memory-safety theorem is asserted by this definition. -/
def boxArray {T : Type} (N : Usize) (s : Slice T) :
    Result (core.result.Result (Array T N) (Slice T)) :=
  if h : s.val.length = N.val then ok (.Ok ⟨s.val,h⟩) else ok (.Err s)
